- 2 -
All orders, issuances, rules and regulations and
other issuances or parts thereof which are inconsistent with the pro-
visions of this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.
This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 10th day of December in the
year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-seven.
borage b. Aguirr
By the President:
Executive Secretary
